collection.title: Mercedes-Benz EQ EQE 2023 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz EQE 2023 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Mercedes-Benz Specific arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
